subject: Quick SEO win for PhysioNow
body:
Hi PhysioNow team,

I was looking at your website and noticed a few quick SEO wins that are costing you traffic:

1. Missing LocalBusiness schema markup for rich search snippets
2. Slow server response time (takes 2.38s to load; hurts mobile rankings)

Rank Ray can fix these in under 48 hours. Want to see a free detailed video audit?

Best,
Rank Ray Team
